coordinate_unit: metres (values recorded in brownie_1.V.global; no rescaling)
surface_definition: Closed four-vertex torso simplex. It is a kinematic surface proxy, not a scanned body surface.
topology_rule: Use exactly these four faces in every frame; do not add limbs, interpolate joints, smooth coordinates, reorient faces from a B4 result, or choose an alternative subset of joints.
frame_validity_rule: A frame is valid only when all 12 declared coordinate values are finite and the signed tetrahedron volume has absolute value greater than 1e-10 m^3. Invalid frames are excluded.
curvature_rule: Use the repository's existing discrete Weingarten implementation on this mesh and reduce finite vertex H values by the arithmetic mean.
